evals.name: kernel-reducer-audit
evals.prompt: The crates/finstack-ai-kernel/src/reducer/ module feels like a mess — I keep forgetting whether apply_record or the legacy helper is the canonical path, and I think there's leftover stuff from an aborted migration. Can you audit it and show me what's actually slop vs. what's real? Scope is just that module. Don't touch any code yet.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 Audit Report following examples/audit-report.md format. Should cover: surface area per capability, specific findings (expected: duplicate helpers, legacy vs shapes pathway, possible trait drift), binding drift check, hazards section, scorecard, top-5 ranked changes. Must stop after Phase 1 and ask for user confirmation before planning.

evals.name: runtime-error-simplify
evals.prompt: look at crates/finstack-ai-runtime/src/ — the error modules look like they might have overlapping structure. also some enums might be bloated. run your simplify workflow on the runtime error types, audit then plan, don't execute anything without me looking
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 Audit Report followed by Phase 2 Consolidation Plan (only if the user's 'audit then plan' is interpreted as wanting both phases). Should properly check Python and WASM bindings. Should flag any serde or public-item fields under behavioral-invariants. Must stop before Phase 3.

evals.name: agent-constructors-full-loop
